title: Round 8 / ECDLP-25: Lean x-only interpolation bound for k (linear) on short Weierstrass curves
question: Using the CurveX/Interpolation infrastructure, determine and formally prove the best degree lower bound for g in F[X] with g(x(kP)) = k for 1 <= k <= N < r/2 (x-only interpolation of the discrete log itself), or record why the second-difference argument degenerates.
rationale: Round-8 selection by PI (autonomous); D2/D3 from ECDLP-22 judged weak as stated, D3 absorbed into ECDLP-24.
success_criteria: Exact statements; verified sources or explicit unverified marks; reproducible evidence; no sorry; corrected variants separate.
resource_limit: One bounded subagent; no recursion; computations < 5 min; no commits; ~75 min.
